headline: [Vietnam stock market] Declines amid weakening global investor sentiment; liquidity weakness and continued foreign selling
summary: The Vietnamese stock market fell after the 60-day US-Iran ceasefire expired on the 17th. Concerns over oil prices and inflation weighed on sentiment, alongside liquidity weakness and foreign selling.
why: The VN-Index is Vietnam's main benchmark, and foreign flows and global risk sentiment strongly influence it.
why_moved: The expiry of the 60-day US-Iran ceasefire raised concerns that the deadlock would weigh on oil prices and inflation. Weaker global investor sentiment and foreign selling added pressure.
